text:
mira: Noticed a client-side storm in sampleapp after STS refresh: 401 -> refresh -> immediate replay causes duplicate paginated requests and 429s from /v1/embeds/batch. repro below.

sam: Minimal repro?

mira: Run sampleapp with prefetch on. Revoke token during warmup so next page requests hit 401 and trigger refresh. When UI triggers 5 concurrent page fetches they all replay and backend rate-limits.

alejandra: Likely missing inflight dedupe on replay. SDK queues requests during refresh and then replays them individually.

chao: Suggest singleflight keyed by (method,path,bodyHash) with TTL ~200ms. That avoids duplicate backend calls while keeping semantics. Also add opt-in flag so admin calls arent coalesced.

mira: Draft JS change: transport adds inflightMap; request opts include coalesce flag default true for prefetcher. On refresh replay we await map to coalesce duplicates. Clone response before returning.

sam: Mirror in Python SDK. Add unit tests mocking auth refresh + integration with stub auth. CI: add small integration job.

alejandra: Add notes to sampleapp README and enable flag in staging for a week.

devex-bot: Created issue #4321 "coalesce inflight paginated requests on token refresh" https://redwood/issue/4321

mira: I'll open JS PR today (branch devex/coalesce-prefetch).

sam: Thanks, this should reduce onboarding 429 noise. :thumbsup:
